_comment_keep_hier: Antenna closure, 2026-08-29. Job 5158 (no keep-hierarchy) routes clean but leaves 26 net / 35 pin antenna violations; all violators terminate in ONE flattened read-decode cone (_36xxx_): sc_stat[*] (7), psram_cur_i0/q0[*] (11), net75/output*/I (8). SYNTH_HIERARCHY_MODE defaults to 'flatten', which smears that cone across the 1675x1110 die and produces the long Metal5 arms; hard module boundaries localise it. CONFIG-ONLY: no source file touched, no port/logic/state change, invisible to simulation, so all cocotb/formal results stay valid bit-for-bit. KEEP-SET IS CONSTRAINED BY THE SDC: pnr_32m_scoped_v25_b6.sdc scopes every MCP with '-through <net>' using FLATTENED net names. Job 5191 kept sc_detector + psram_buf_ctrl too and renamed their internals, so 169 '-through' lookups failed (STA-0361; baseline has 0) and OpenROAD SEGFAULTed writing the SDC back out (WriteSdc::writeExceptionThru -> sortByPathName on the stale NetSet) at step 32. The SDC only references u_sc.*, u_psram.*, u_pcfsm.*, u_dec.*, u_tacc.*, u_comb.* internals plus TOP-LEVEL rb_* wires - so reg_bank and trouper_ahb8_adapter are the only two modules safe to keep without rewriting the SDC, and they are precisely where the offending decode cone lives. Job 5191 measured the area cost at +2.9% (1102K->1134K um2).
_comment_drv_closure: DRV (max slew / max cap) closure, SGE job 5105 (t4b), 2026-08-27. Baseline job 4780 signed off with 1060/115 max-slew/max-cap violations at nom_tt (1963/160 at SS) because the only DRV repair ran on estimated parasitics and found the design ~clean. Enabling the post-GRT resizer-timing pass plus widening the design-repair slew/cap margins to 65% drops that to 10/4 (nom_tt) / 15/6 (SS), DRC/LVS clean, WNS unchanged (SS actually -16.97 -> -15.71). Do NOT add set_max_transition/set_max_capacitance to the SDC to push further: any design-wide value stalls repair_design on this netlist for 70+ min (trials t3/t5/t6). Residual ~15 pins are a documented waiver (quasi-static MCP-relaxed sc_detector-decode / training_acc cones + 2 output-path buffers).
